description: Binary-log reader prototypes and final installed-wheel comparisons. Ratios are candidate/baseline; lower is better. Nine samples, 30 interleaved blocks each. wide is a MessagePack record with 128 top-level keys; shortread returns at most seven bytes per stream call.

baselines.final: Prior wheel versus final installed wheel
baselines.installed: Prior wheel versus earlier integrated read-loop version
baselines.combined: Prior installed wheel versus combined scratch prototype
baselines.picopdirect: Cython dictionary scan versus picop dictionary iteration
baselines.bytespicop: Cython exact-byte check versus picop bytes_check_exact
baselines.lens: Original compiled read loop versus typed byte-length candidate
baselines.lenrepeat: Original compiled read loop versus typed byte-length candidate
baselines.lendirect: Typed Cython byte length versus picop bytes_len
